observedIntent: Cute cartoon holiday animals dominate, with big eyes, clean outlines and isolated silhouettes.

existingContentCheck.relatedSourceConclusion: Four strongest related deer originals inspected: two spotted fawn-style deer and two slender generic stags. These are not the broad-muzzled reindeer collection; no exact prior reindeer composition identified.

countingRule: One accepted unique ID per independent composition. Repair versions and exports never count twice.
